papers.title: Lymphangiogenesis is Critical for Healing and Survival in a Murine Model of Laryngotracheal Injury
papers.translated_title: 淋巴管生成对喉气管损伤小鼠模型的愈合和生存至关重要
papers.author: Gulleman, P.
papers.summary: Objective: Lymphatic dysfunction has been implicated in exacerbating fibrosis in numerous diseases, yet the role of the lymphatic system in laryngotracheal injury has not previously been explored. This study aims to evaluate lymphatic vascular remodeling in a murine model of laryngotracheal stenosis (LTS) and determine how pharmacologic blockade of lymphangiogenesis impacts airway healing after mucosal injury. Methods: LTS was induced in C57BL6 mice using an established chemomechanical injury model. Lymphatic density was quantified using LYVE-1 immunohistochemistry. Mice were treated with the VEGFR-3-selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor SAR131675 to block lymphangiogenesis after injury. Outcomes assessed included survival, histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and Evans blue dye vascular leakage. Results: Laryngotracheal injury induced a substantial increase in subepithelial lymphatic vessel density concomitant with fibrotic remodeling. Pharmacologic inhibition of VEGFR-3 signaling with SAR131675 abrogated this lymphangiogenic response and resulted in markedly increased mortality, impaired epithelial repair with obstructive sloughing, increased edema, and persistent histopathologic evidence of tissue injury. A qualitative increase in pathologic fibrocellular remodeling was also observed, though with no measurable difference in lamina propria thickness. Conclusion: These findings establish lymphatic remodeling as an essential component of successful airway repair following mucosal injury. Lymphatic dysfunction is a common feature of known risk factors for LTS including diabetes, obesity, and prematurity, and can be exacerbated by positive pressure ventilation. Disruption of the lymphangiogenic response to airway injury may lead to stasis of pro-inflammatory factors that result in chronic inflammation, maladaptive remodeling, and pathologic tissue changes. The lymphatic vasculature is a viable target for future mechanistic study and potential therapeutic intervention following airway injury.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：淋巴功能障碍已被认为会在多种疾病中加剧纤维化，但淋巴系统在喉气管损伤中的作用此前尚未被探讨。本研究旨在评估喉气管狭窄（LTS）小鼠模型中的淋巴血管重塑，并确定药物性阻断淋巴管生成如何影响黏膜损伤后的气道愈合。方法：采用已建立的化学机械损伤模型在C57BL6小鼠中诱导LTS。使用LYVE-1免疫组化定量淋巴管密度。小鼠在损伤后接受VEGFR-3选择性酪氨酸激酶抑制剂SAR131675治疗以阻断淋巴管生成。评估的结局包括生存率、组织病理学、免疫组化和Evans蓝染料血管渗漏。结果：喉气管损伤诱导上皮下淋巴管密度显著增加，并伴随纤维化重塑。使用SAR131675对VEGFR-3信号进行药物性抑制消除了这种淋巴管生成反应，并导致死亡率显著增加、上皮修复受损伴阻塞性脱落、水肿增加以及持续的组织损伤组织病理学证据。还观察到病理性纤维细胞重塑的定性增加，但固有层厚度无 measurable 差异。结论：这些发现确立了淋巴重塑是黏膜损伤后成功气道修复的重要组成部分。淋巴功能障碍是LTS已知危险因素（包括糖尿病、肥胖和早产）的共同特征，并可被正压通气加重。对气道损伤的淋巴管生成反应的破坏可能导致促炎因子淤滞，从而引起慢性炎症、适应不良性重塑和病理性组织改变。淋巴血管系统是气道损伤后未来机制研究和潜在治疗干预的可行靶点。

papers.title: Head movement allocation in freely-moving macaques learning object-context sequences
papers.translated_title: 自由活动猕猴学习物体-情境序列时的头部运动分配
papers.author: Rahman, K. F.
papers.summary: Flexible learning and long-term memory are hallmark features of primate cognition that are shaped by interactions with changing environments. A comprehensive understanding of these brain-body-environment interactions requires minimal constraints on behavior, and environments rich with conditional cues that encourage diverse behavioral dynamics. In this study, we introduce a multi-level enclosure (Treehouse) that allows for independent control of spatially distributed touchscreens for studying cognition in freely moving macaques. To test flexible learning, two monkeys completed trials consisting of a regular sequence of conditional object choices (targets) across four distinct spatiotemporal contexts (screens). Both monkeys acquired numerous unique, conditional object-context sequences without detriment to new learning as memoranda accumulated. They also successfully recalled their correct choices after weeks without exposure. To assess how monkeys allocate movement during learning and memory-guided decision making, we tracked their head kinematics and used recurrent neural networks to decode different aspects of their engagement with the environment during the choice epoch of the task. One such model predicted the position of the object about to be touched, including on error trials, tracking overt gaze towards objects. Separate models decoded sequence corner, the ordinal step, and the individual screen stations the monkeys occupied, despite identical stimulus layouts and behavioral demands at each station. Head movements also showed efficiencies that the task did not require: under conditions of uncertainty, monkeys were biased in their initial search locations to the targets that were closest to reach, and across days they made smoother head movements as training progressed, with no change in accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of immersive 3-D environments, in which body kinematics can shed light on animals' goals, and reveal that situated learning in primates can be rapid, capacious, durable, and flexible.
papers.translated_summary: 灵活学习和长期记忆是灵长类认知的标志性特征，这些特征在与不断变化的环境互动中得以塑造。要全面理解这些大脑-身体-环境的交互作用，需要对行为施加最小约束，并需要充满条件性线索的环境以鼓励多样化的行为动态。在本研究中，我们引入了一种多层围栏（Treehouse），允许独立控制空间分布式的触摸屏，用于研究自由活动猕猴的认知。为测试灵活学习，两只猴子完成了由条件性物体选择（目标）的规则序列组成的试验，跨越四个不同的时空情境（屏幕）。两只猴子习得了大量独特的、条件性的物体-情境序列，且随着记忆项积累，新学习未受损害。它们还能在数周未接触后成功回忆起正确的选择。为评估猴子在学习和记忆引导决策过程中如何分配运动，我们追踪了其头部运动学，并使用循环神经网络解码其在任务选择阶段与环境互动的不同方面。其中一个模型预测了即将被触摸物体的位置，包括在错误试验中，追踪了对物体的外显注视。其他模型分别解码了序列角落、序数步骤以及猴子所处的各个屏幕站点，尽管每个站点的刺激布局和行为要求完全相同。头部运动还表现出任务并未要求的效率：在不确定条件下，猴子在初始搜索位置上偏向于距离最近的目标；且随着训练进展，跨天头部运动变得更加平滑，而准确性没有变化。这些结果展示了沉浸式三维环境的潜力——在其中身体运动学可以揭示动物的目标——并揭示了灵长类的情境化学习可以是快速的、容量大的、持久的和灵活的。

papers.title: A rational design strategy and validation for protease-resistant fusion-inhibitor antiviral peptides
papers.translated_title: 抗蛋白酶融合抑制抗病毒肽的理性设计策略与验证
papers.author: Yang, K.
papers.summary: Peptide-based fusion inhibitors are promising pharmaceuticals in the fight against enveloped viruses relying on membrane fusion for host infection. However, peptide therapeutic applications have long been hindered by their poor stability in vivo. Here, we discovered that peptide inhibitors with the wildtype sequence of the heptad repeat 2 (HR2) domain of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein are efficiently cleaved by Transmembrane Protease, Serine 2 (TMPRSS2), a key protease involved in the SARS-CoV-2 virus-cell fusion pathway. We then identified the corresponding cleavage sites and designed three protease-resistant peptides using ranking based on deep mutational scanning and natural occurrence. The three candidates all exhibit inhibitory activity in a cell-cell fusion assay. A high-resolution cryo-EM structure of the top candidate, HR2-NHN, bound to its HR1 target reveals the molecular basis for its potent activity. The top candidate of the cell-based screening assay showed significantly improved efficacy relative to the wildtype peptide when administered at different times before infection in both an authentic virus-cell infection assay and a mouse assay. More broadly, our results suggest that the design strategies for protease-resistant peptides could be applied to a broad spectrum of other enveloped viruses and pave the way for the development of safe, prophylactic antivirals that can be administered before exposure.
papers.translated_summary: 基于肽的融合抑制剂是抗击依赖膜融合感染宿主的包膜病毒的有前景的药物。然而，肽类治疗应用长期以来受限于其在体内的稳定性较差。在此，我们发现，具有SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白七肽重复序列2（HR2）结构域野生型序列的肽抑制剂会被跨膜丝氨酸蛋白酶2（TMPRSS2）高效切割，后者是参与SARS-CoV-2病毒-细胞融合途径的关键蛋白酶。随后，我们鉴定了相应的切割位点，并基于深度突变扫描和自然发生的排序设计了三种抗蛋白酶肽。这三种候选肽在细胞-细胞融合实验中均表现出抑制活性。排名第一的候选肽HR2-NHN与其HR1靶标结合的高分辨率冷冻电镜结构揭示了其强效活性的分子基础。在真实病毒-细胞感染实验和小鼠实验中，当在感染前不同时间给药时，基于细胞的筛选实验中的排名第一候选肽相对于野生型肽显示出显著改善的效力。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，抗蛋白酶肽的设计策略可应用于广泛的其它包膜病毒，并为开发可在暴露前给药的安全预防性抗病毒药物铺平了道路。

papers.title: Regulatory plasticity of the rdar biofilm morphotype in clinical uropathogenic Escherichia coli and its modulation by ciprofloxacin
papers.translated_title: 临床尿路致病性大肠杆菌中rdar生物膜形态型的调控可塑性及其受环丙沙星的调节
papers.author: Mushtaq, F.
papers.summary: Background: Red, dry and rough (rdar) biofilm formation in Escherichia coli is characterized by the coordinated production of extracellular cellulose and amyloid curli fimbriae. Although rdar biofilm formation has been extensively characterized in laboratory strains, its clinical relevance and implications for antimicrobial treatment remain poorly understood. Methods: We screened 146 consecutive E. coli isolates from patients with urinary tract infections in Lahore, Pakistan (2017-2019) for Congo red morphotypes at 28 degrees C and 37 degrees C. Antimicrobial susceptibility was determined by disc diffusion and compared between morphotypes using the Fisher exact test. Fourteen isolates were whole-genome sequenced, the csgD-csgBA intergenic region was aligned, and csgD expression was quantified by qRT-PCR. The effect of 10 micrograms/mL ciprofloxacin on rdar morphotype expression, matrix ultrastructure and biofilm formation was examined in ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates (MIC at least 128 micrograms/mL). Results: Rdar-like colony morphotypes were expressed by 36.3% (53/146) of isolates at 28 degrees C and 29.5% (43/146) at 37 degrees C. Nucleotide polymorphisms in the csgD-csgBA intergenic region clustered within annotated OmpR, IHF and CsgD binding regions and were associated with, but did not individually predict, the mode of rdar morphotype expression. Isolates carrying the rdar morphotype were distributed across diverse E. coli phylogroups and sequence types. Resistance to aztreonam, cefuroxime and cephradine was more frequent among smooth and white isolates, whereas resistance to nitrofurantoin was more frequent among isolates rdar-positive at 28 degrees C (45.2% versus 20.2%, p = 0.0097); fluoroquinolone resistance did not differ between morphotypes. Subinhibitory ciprofloxacin (10 micrograms/mL) suppressed rdar biofilm formation, disrupted extracellular matrix architecture and abolished surface colonization on glass, in ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates. Conclusions: Our findings establish the rdar morphotype as a clinically relevant biofilm phenotype in uropathogenic E. coli and show that subinhibitory ciprofloxacin suppresses rdar biofilm formation in ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates. These results underscore the importance of considering antibiotic-mediated modulation of biofilm behavior when interpreting treatment responses and designing strategies to combat persistent urinary tract infections.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：大肠埃希菌中红色、干燥和粗糙（rdar）生物膜形成的特征在于细胞外纤维素和淀粉样卷曲菌毛的协同产生。尽管rdar生物膜形成已在实验室菌株中得到广泛表征，但其临床相关性及对抗菌治疗的意义仍知之甚少。方法：我们筛查了巴基斯坦拉合尔尿路感染患者中连续分离的146株大肠埃希菌（2017—2019年），在28摄氏度和37摄氏度下检测刚果红形态型。采用纸片扩散法测定抗菌药物敏感性，并使用Fisher精确检验比较不同形态型之间的差异。对14株分离株进行全基因组测序，比对csgD-csgBA基因间区，并通过qRT-PCR定量csgD表达。在环丙沙星耐药分离株（MIC至少128微克/毫升）中，检测10微克/毫升环丙沙星对rdar形态型表达、基质超微结构和生物膜形成的影响。结果：在28摄氏度下，36.3%（53/146）的分离株表达rdar样菌落形态型；在37摄氏度下为29.5%（43/146）。csgD-csgBA基因间区的核苷酸多态性聚集于注释的OmpR、IHF和CsgD结合区域内，并与rdar形态型表达模式相关，但不能单独预测该模式。携带rdar形态型的分离株分布于不同的大肠埃希菌系统发育群和序列型中。对氨曲南、头孢呋辛和头孢拉定的耐药在光滑型和白色分离株中更常见，而对呋喃妥因的耐药在28摄氏度下rdar阳性分离株中更常见（45.2%对20.2%，p=0.0097）；氟喹诺酮类耐药在不同形态型之间无差异。在环丙沙星耐药分离株中，亚抑菌浓度环丙沙星（10微克/毫升）抑制rdar生物膜形成，破坏细胞外基质结构，并消除玻璃表面的定植。结论：我们的研究结果确立rdar形态型是尿路致病性大肠埃希菌中具有临床相关性的生物膜表型，并表明亚抑菌浓度环丙沙星可抑制环丙沙星耐药分离株中的rdar生物膜形成。这些结果强调，在解释治疗反应和设计对抗持续性尿路感染的策略时，考虑抗生素介导的生物膜行为调节具有重要意义。

papers.title: Naked antisense oligonucleotides access the cytosol during early endocytic trafficking
papers.translated_title: 裸反义寡核苷酸在早期内吞运输过程中进入细胞质。
papers.author: Sitarska, E.
papers.summary: Phosphorothioate-modified antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) enter cells, but their site of productive escape remains uncertain. We combined live-cell imaging and ratiometric pH measurements to follow a Malat1-targeting ASO internalized without a delivery vehicle. In U2OS cells, less than 4% of internalized ASO reached the nucleus under conditions that reduced Malat1 RNA by >90%. Most ASO accumulated in late endosomes, endolysosomes and lysosomes as foci and broadly distributed luminal signal. These compartments underwent neutralization without detectable membrane rupture or galectin-3 recruitment. ASO foci showed constrained motion, consistent with association with endolysosomal constituents. L-leucyl-L-leucine methyl ester-induced membrane damage or Calcium dependent lysosome exocytosis released dextran while retaining luminal ASO. Loss of the stress-granule scaffolding proteins G3BP1/2 modestly enhanced ASO activity without detectable endolysosomal damage. Tantalosin, a small molecule that perturbs endosomal recycling, redistributed the ESCRT-III protein IST1 to endosomes. It enhanced early escape of SYTOX Green and ASOs, detected by nuclear accumulation, and increased Malat1 knockdown, with cell-type-dependent responses. Tantalosin did not detectably increase nuclear ASO accumulation after sequestration in late compartments. These findings place productive ASO escape early in endocytic trafficking, most likely in early or recycling endosomes, before sequestration in largely nonproductive late compartments.
papers.translated_summary: 硫代磷酸修饰的反义寡核苷酸（ASOs）可进入细胞，但其有效逃逸位点仍不确定。我们结合活细胞成像与比率型pH测量，追踪了无需递送载体即可内化的靶向Malat1的ASO。在U2OS细胞中，在使Malat1 RNA减少超过90%的条件下，内化的ASO中不到4%到达细胞核。大多数ASO以灶状和广泛分布的腔内信号形式积累于晚期内体、内溶酶体和溶酶体中。这些区室发生了中和，但未检测到膜破裂或galectin-3募集。ASO灶表现出受限运动，与和内溶酶体组分结合相一致。L-亮氨酰-L-亮氨酸甲酯诱导的膜损伤或钙依赖性溶酶体胞吐释放了葡聚糖，但保留了腔内ASO。应激颗粒支架蛋白G3BP1/2的缺失适度增强了ASO活性，而未检测到内溶酶体损伤。Tantalosin是一种干扰内体循环的小分子，可将ESCRT-III蛋白IST1重新分布至内体。它促进了SYTOX Green和ASOs的早期逃逸，通过核积累检测到，并增加了Malat1敲低，且反应具有细胞类型依赖性。Tantalosin在ASO被隔离于晚期区室后并未可检测地增加核内ASO积累。这些发现表明，有效的ASO逃逸发生在内吞运输的早期，最可能是在早期或循环内体中，早于在基本无生产力的晚期区室中被隔离。

papers.title: Evolutionary Coupling of Flagellar Motility and Type VI Secretion Systems Across Bacteria
papers.translated_title: 细菌中鞭毛运动与VI型分泌系统的进化耦合
papers.author: Philip, J. S.
papers.summary: Bacteria use both motility and antagonism to compete in spatially structured environments, but whether these traits evolve together across broad bacterial diversity remains unclear. We developed a spatial kin-competition model predicting that motility should couple robustly with contact-dependent weapons by increasing encounter rates with competitors, whereas coupling with diffusible weapons should be weaker and context-dependent. To examine the evolutionary hypotheses motivated by the model, we performed a comprehensive analysis of 11,365 bacterial genomes across the bacterial Tree of Life (ToL). By utilising large-scale homology-based searches, we annotated flagellar, T6SS, and bacteriocin components and then applied phylogenetic comparative models to examine evolutionary associations. T6SS presence was strongly associated with flagellar motility: T6SS-positive lineages were predominantly flagellated, and BayesTraits supported a dependent model of FliC and T6SS evolution. In contrast, bacteriocins did not show detectable evolutionary coupling with flagellar motility. Transition-rate analyses further indicated that T6SS gain was strongly biased towards motile bacterial lineages, even though T6SS loss was common overall. These results indicate different macroevolutionary associations of flagellar motility with T6SS and bacteriocins, consistent with the qualitative hypothesis motivated by our model.
papers.translated_summary: 细菌利用运动性和拮抗作用在空间结构环境中竞争，但这些性状是否在广泛的细菌多样性中协同演化仍不清楚。我们开发了一个空间亲缘竞争模型，预测运动性应通过增加与竞争者的相遇率而与接触依赖性武器稳健耦合，而与可扩散武器的耦合则应较弱且依赖情境。为检验该模型提出的演化假说，我们对细菌生命之树（ToL）中11365个细菌基因组进行了全面分析。利用大规模同源性搜索，我们注释了鞭毛、T6SS和细菌素组分，然后应用系统发育比较模型来检验演化关联。T6SS的存在与鞭毛运动性强烈相关：T6SS阳性谱系主要为有鞭毛的，BayesTraits支持FliC和T6SS演化的依赖模型。相比之下，细菌素未显示出与鞭毛运动性可检测的演化耦合。转移率分析进一步表明，T6SS获得强烈偏向于运动性细菌谱系，尽管T6SS丢失总体上很常见。这些结果表明鞭毛运动性与T6SS和细菌素具有不同的大演化关联，这与我们的模型所提出的定性假说一致。

papers.title: Convergent genome- and gene-level constraints shape repeated environmental adaptation in grasses
papers.translated_title: 趋同的基因组和基因层面约束塑造了禾本科植物反复的环境适应
papers.author: Hsu, S.-K.
papers.summary: Grasses (Poaceae) dominate terrestrial ecosystems and sustain global food security, yet the genomic principles enabling their repeated adaptation to extreme environments remain unresolved. Combining dense phylogenomic sampling, global environmental data, and genomic large language models (gLLMs), we characterize the mutational targets underlying environmental shift across 687 genomes from 561 species spanning 17 climate zones. We identify 17-30 phylogenetically independent transitions into extreme temperature, water, and soil environments, accompanied by convergent shifts in genome-scale molecular properties, including the Nitrogen-to-Carbon balance and the biosynthetic cost of the proteome. Our gLLMs-informed phylogenetic mixed modeling framework identifies 330 genes that repeatedly associated with distinct axes of environmental variation, highlighting the importance of protein modification and localization within extracellular and organellar compartments. Overlaying independent convergent selection tests identifies 27 high-confidence candidates for further characterization. Together, our results show that grass adaptation is canalized by layered constraints at genome-wide and gene-specific scales, producing predictable evolutionary trajectories.
papers.translated_summary: 禾本科植物（Poaceae）主导陆地生态系统并支撑全球粮食安全，然而使其反复适应极端环境的基因组原理仍未得到解析。结合密集的系统发育基因组采样、全球环境数据和基因组大语言模型（gLLMs），我们刻画了跨越17个气候带、561个物种的687个基因组中环境转变所对应的突变靶点。我们识别出17至30次系统发育上独立的向极端温度、水分和土壤环境的转变，并伴随基因组尺度分子特性的趋同变化，包括氮碳平衡和蛋白质组的生物合成成本。我们的gLLMs信息驱动的系统发育混合建模框架识别出330个反复与不同环境变异轴相关的基因，突显了蛋白质修饰及其在胞外和细胞器区室中定位的重要性。叠加独立的趋同选择检验，我们识别出27个高置信度候选基因以供进一步表征。总之，我们的结果表明，禾本科植物的适应受到全基因组和基因特异性尺度上多层次约束的渠化，产生可预测的演化轨迹。

papers.title: Artificial Reactivation of a Cocaine-Associated Ensembles in the Dorsal Dentate Gyrus Attenuates Cocaine Prime-Induced Reinstatement of Drug-Seeking
papers.translated_title: 背侧齿状回中可卡因相关神经集合的人工再激活减弱可卡因启动诱导的觅药行为复吸
papers.author: Edwards, L. H.
papers.summary: Relapse-prevention strategies aimed at reducing relapse following abstinence primarily focus on reducing cravings that lead to drug-seeking triggered by stress, drug-related cues, or re-exposure to the drug. Because addictive drugs form persistent associative contextual memories, we investigated how reactivation of cocaine-related hippocampal memories influences subsequent drug-seeking. Here, we tagged dorsal dentate gyrus (dDG) memory ensembles involved in encoding either a first or fourth cocaine exposure (15mg/kg, i.p) in male and female c57BL/6 mice using a TetTag approach. Mice underwent cocaine conditioned place preference (CPP), extinction, and reinstatement. We assessed whether optical reactivation of tagged cocaine-related ensembles could substitute for a cocaine priming injection to reinstate CPP, whether reactivation altered cocaine-induced reinstatement, and if these effects differed depending on stage of drug exposure. We also compared these effects to reactivation of saline-associated ensembles. Cocaine produced robust locomotor activation during conditioning and sensitization developed across repeated drug exposures. Reactivation of a cocaine-related engram alone did not reinstate CPP. However, reactivation of the first cocaine exposure engram attenuated cocaine-induced reinstatement. In contrast, reactivation of the fourth exposure engram did not confer this protective effect. Interestingly, reactivation of saline-associated ensembles also reduced cocaine-induced reinstatement specifically in females, suggesting dDG ensemble reactivation may modulate relapse-related behavior through interference or neuromodulatory disruption of cocaine-associated representations, consistent with our prior work. These findings raise the possibility that early contextual experiences form competing or destabilizing representations that interfere with later cocaine-seeking when reactivated. Females also displayed greater sensitivity to locomotor-inducing effects of cocaine memory reactivation, although this was dissociated from CPP. Together, these findings show that cocaine memories are distinct across drug experience and selective reactivation of dDG engrams can differentially influence drug-seeking.
papers.translated_summary: 旨在减少戒断后复吸的预防策略主要集中于降低由应激、药物相关线索或再次暴露于药物所触发的、导致觅药行为的渴求。由于成瘾性药物会形成持久的关联性情境记忆，我们研究了 cocaine 相关海马记忆的再激活如何影响随后的觅药行为。在此，我们使用 TetTag 方法在雄性和雌性 c57BL/6 小鼠中标记了背侧齿状回（dDG）记忆集合，这些集合参与编码首次或第四次 cocaine 暴露（15mg/kg，腹腔注射）。小鼠接受了 cocaine 条件位置偏好（CPP）、消退和复吸实验。我们评估了标记的 cocaine 相关集合的光学再激活是否可以替代 cocaine 启动注射以恢复 CPP，再激活是否改变 cocaine 诱导的复吸，以及这些效应是否因药物暴露阶段而异。我们还将这些效应与生理盐水相关集合的再激活进行了比较。Cocaine 在条件化过程中产生了强烈的运动激活，并且在反复药物暴露中发展出敏化。仅再激活 cocaine 相关印迹并不能恢复 CPP。然而，再激活首次 cocaine 暴露印迹减弱了 cocaine 诱导的复吸。相比之下，再激活第四次暴露印迹并未赋予这种保护效应。有趣的是，再激活生理盐水相关集合也减少了 cocaine 诱导的复吸，且仅在雌性中如此，这表明 dDG 集合再激活可能通过干扰或神经调质性破坏 cocaine 相关表征来调节复吸相关行为，这与我们先前的工作一致。这些发现提出了一种可能性，即早期情境体验形成了竞争性或去稳定化的表征，当被再激活时会干扰后来的觅药行为。雌性还表现出对 cocaine 记忆再激活的运动诱导效应更大的敏感性，尽管这与 CPP 相分离。总之，这些发现表明 cocaine 记忆在不同药物体验中具有差异性，并且 dDG 印迹的选择性再激活可以差异性地影响觅药行为。

papers.title: SMARTFlexDB: a paired apo-holo RNA structure database and analysis platform for RNA conformational flexibility and small-molecule recognition
papers.translated_title: SMARTFlexDB：一个配对apo-holo RNA结构数据库及分析平台，用于RNA构象灵活性和小分子识别
papers.author: Jiang, S.
papers.summary: RNA structures can undergo substantial conformational changes upon small-molecule binding, yet existing structural resources provide only static RNA-ligand snapshots without connecting ligand-bound (holo) RNA structures to corresponding ligand-free (apo) conformations. SMARTFlexDB is a curated database and analysis platform that uses paired apo-holo RNA structures to characterize conformational differences and RNA-small molecule recognition. Candidate pairs were identified from the Protein Data Bank by matching RNA chains with at least 90% sequence identity and coverage, and fully conserved binding pocket nucleotides. The current release contains 434 binding pockets from 266 holo structures, linked to 186 apo structures to yield 1187 pocket-level apo-holo pairs organized into 734 database entries, spanning 150 small molecules and 23 RNA functional classes. Each entry integrates RNA sequence and secondary-structure annotations, apo and holo three-dimensional structures, RNA-ligand atomic interactions, and quantitative descriptors of global and local conformational changes. An interactive web interface enables users to explore sequence alignments and structural overlays, compare secondary structures and RNA motifs, and upload paired apo-holo structures for customized analysis. By linking ligand-bound and ligand-free RNA structures, SMARTFlexDB provides a robust foundation for investigating RNA structural flexibility and supporting RNA-targeted small-molecule drug discovery. The database and analysis platform are available at https://aidd.rc.ufl.edu/app/smartflexdb/.
papers.translated_summary: RNA结构在小分子结合后可发生显著的构象变化，然而现有结构资源仅提供静态的RNA-配体快照，未将配体结合态（holo）RNA结构与相应的无配体（apo）构象关联起来。SMARTFlexDB是一个经过整理的数据库与分析平台，利用配对的apo-holo RNA结构来表征构象差异及RNA-小分子识别。候选配对通过匹配序列一致性和覆盖率至少90%且结合口袋核苷酸完全保守的RNA链，从蛋白质数据库中鉴定获得。当前版本包含来自266个holo结构的434个结合口袋，关联至186个apo结构，产生1187个口袋水平的apo-holo配对，组织为734条数据库条目，涵盖150种小分子和23个RNA功能类别。每条条目整合了RNA序列与二级结构注释、apo与holo三维结构、RNA-配体原子相互作用以及全局和局部构象变化的定量描述符。交互式网络界面使用户能够探索序列比对与结构叠加、比较二级结构和RNA基序，并上传配对的apo-holo结构进行定制分析。通过关联配体结合态与无配体RNA结构，SMARTFlexDB为研究RNA结构柔性及支持RNA靶向小分子药物发现提供了坚实基础。数据库与分析平台可在https://aidd.rc.ufl.edu/app/smartflexdb/获取。

papers.title: Identification of cis-Acting Elements that Regulate Influenza A Virus Segment 7 Differential mRNA Splicing
papers.translated_title: 鉴定调控甲型流感病毒第7节段差异mRNA剪接的顺式作用元件
papers.author: Zhou, S.
papers.summary: Influenza A virus segment 7 encodes the M1 matrix protein and M2 ion channel from an unspliced primary transcript (mRNA1) and spliced mRNA2, respectively. Both proteins are essential for efficient virus replication, but the intrinsic sequences that determine segment 7 splicing balance are not fully defined. Here, we systematically investigated how conserved cis-acting splicing elements regulate segment splicing. We found that while the splice acceptor sequence is optimal, both potential upstream polypyrimidine tracts regulate splicing, with the 5' region acting positively and the 3' region negatively to maintain M1 expression. Nucleotide A713 is the most likely mRNA2 branch point, but potentially with redundancy from other local adenosines. Mutagenesis of the mRNA2 splice donor sequence showed that it is nearly optimal but that nucleotides 51 and 55 modestly downregulate splicing efficiency. Most introduced mutations that change splicing balance are nonsynonymous in M1. Nevertheless, polypyrimidine tract and branch point mutations that significantly perturbed M1:M2 balance resulted in viable viruses. In contrast, the splice donor sequence was largely intolerant of mutation. We conclude that M1:M2 balance is maintained via suboptimal splice donor and polypyrimidine tract splicing signals, with the latter allowing more evolutionary flexibility to vary the ratio and/or M1 sequence
papers.translated_summary: 甲型流感病毒第7节段分别由未剪接的初级转录本（mRNA1）和剪接后的mRNA2编码M1基质蛋白和M2离子通道。这两种蛋白对高效病毒复制均必不可少，但决定第7节段剪接平衡的内在序列尚未完全明确。在此，我们系统研究了保守的顺式作用剪接元件如何调控节段剪接。我们发现，虽然剪接受体序列是最优的，但两个潜在的上游多聚嘧啶序列均调控剪接，其中5'区域起正向作用，3'区域起负向作用以维持M1表达。核苷酸A713最可能是mRNA2的分支点，但可能与其他局部腺苷存在冗余。对mRNA2剪接供体序列的突变分析表明，该序列接近最优，但核苷酸51和55适度下调剪接效率。大多数改变剪接平衡的引入突变在M1中为非同义突变。然而，显著扰动M1:M2平衡的多聚嘧啶序列和分支点突变仍产生有活力的病毒。相比之下，剪接供体序列在很大程度上不耐受突变。我们得出结论：M1:M2平衡通过次优的剪接供体和多聚嘧啶序列剪接信号得以维持，后者允许更大的进化灵活性以改变比例和/或M1序列。
